summary: CONFLICT: Construction timeline discrepancy - DMJM-Lehner study estimates ~10 years, other sources estimate ~20 years.
content: verifier-conflicts-1: EV-0017 (Wikipedia) reports the DMJM-Lehner construction management study estimates completion in ~10 years at 180 blocks/hour, while the same source and others (EV-0013, EV-0019, sciencefocus) state the Great Pyramid was completed in ~20 years. This is a medium-severity discrepancy between engineering-model estimates and historical estimates. Both are estimates; no primary source gives a definitive duration. Recommended: report as a range (10-20 years) with the uncertainty noted.
